theorem QOU.Habiro.quotientEval_bondCount {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (ζ : R) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hζ : ζ ^ N = 1) (e : ι → Polynomial R ⧸ Ideal.span {qPochPoly R N}) (n : ι → ℕ) :
(cyclotomicQuotientEval ζ hN hζ) (∑ i ∈ s, ↑(n i) * e i) = ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(n i) * (cyclotomicQuotientEval ζ hN hζ) (e i)

theorem QOU.Habiro.map_bondCount {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (e : ι → Polynomial R) (n : ι → ℕ) (ζ : R) :
(cyclotomicEvalHom ζ) (∑ i ∈ s, ↑(n i) * e i) = ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(n i) * (cyclotomicEvalHom ζ) (e i)

theorem QOU.Habiro.habiroEval_one_ne_succ_of_not_root {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (ζ : R) (h : ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → ζ ^ k ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) :
habiroEval (fun (x : ℕ) => 1) ζ (N + 1) ≠ habiroEval (fun (x : ℕ) => 1) ζ N

theorem QOU.Habiro.habiroEval_one_succ_sub {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (ζ : R) (N : ℕ) :
habiroEval (fun (x : ℕ) => 1) ζ (N + 1) - habiroEval (fun (x : ℕ) => 1) ζ N = Common.qPochDiag ζ N

theorem QOU.Habiro.qPochDiag_ne_zero_of_not_root {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (ζ : R) (h : ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → ζ ^ k ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) :
Common.qPochDiag ζ N ≠ 0

theorem QOU.Habiro.exists_pow_eq_one_of_qPochDiag_eq_zero {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (ζ : R) {N : ℕ} (h : Common.qPochDiag ζ N = 0) :
∃ (k : ℕ), 0 < k ∧ k ≤ N ∧ ζ ^ k = 1

theorem QOU.Habiro.habiroPoly_one_mul {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a b : ℕ → R) :
habiroPoly (fun (m : ℕ) => if m = 0 then a 0 * b 0 else 0) 1 = habiroPoly a 1 * habiroPoly b 1

theorem QOU.Habiro.habiroEval_mul_of_repr {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a b c : ℕ → R) (ζ : R) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hζ : ζ ^ N = 1) (hc : qPochPoly R N ∣ habiroPoly c N - habiroPoly a N * habiroPoly b N) :
habiroEval c ζ N = habiroEval a ζ N * habiroEval b ζ N

theorem QOU.Habiro.habiroEval_eq_quotientEval {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a : ℕ → R) (ζ : R) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hζ : ζ ^ N = 1) :
habiroEval a ζ N = (cyclotomicQuotientEval ζ hN hζ) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {qPochPoly R N})) (habiroPoly a N))

theorem QOU.Habiro.cyclotomicQuotientEval_mk {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (ζ : R) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hζ : ζ ^ N = 1) (p : Polynomial R) :
(cyclotomicQuotientEval ζ hN hζ) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {qPochPoly R N})) p) = Polynomial.eval ζ p

noncomputable def QOU.Habiro.cyclotomicQuotientEval {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (ζ : R) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hζ : ζ ^ N = 1) :
Polynomial R ⧸ Ideal.span {qPochPoly R N} →+* R

theorem QOU.Habiro.span_qPochPoly_le_ker {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (ζ : R) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hζ : ζ ^ N = 1) :
Ideal.span {qPochPoly R N} ≤ RingHom.ker (cyclotomicEvalHom ζ)

theorem QOU.Habiro.qPochPoly_mem_ker {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (ζ : R) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hζ : ζ ^ N = 1) :
qPochPoly R N ∈ RingHom.ker (cyclotomicEvalHom ζ)

theorem QOU.Habiro.eval_qPochPoly_eq_zero_of_pow_eq_one {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (ζ : R) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hζ : ζ ^ N = 1) :
Polynomial.eval ζ (qPochPoly R N) = 0

theorem QOU.Habiro.habiroEval_eq_cyclotomicEvalHom {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a : ℕ → R) (ζ : R) (N : ℕ) :
habiroEval a ζ N = (cyclotomicEvalHom ζ) (habiroPoly a N)

theorem QOU.Habiro.cyclotomicEvalHom_apply {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (ζ : R) (p : Polynomial R) :
(cyclotomicEvalHom ζ) p = Polynomial.eval ζ p

noncomputable def QOU.Habiro.cyclotomicEvalHom {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (ζ : R) :
Polynomial R →+* R

theorem QOU.Habiro.eval_habiroPoly {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a : ℕ → R) (ζ : R) (N : ℕ) :
Polynomial.eval ζ (habiroPoly a N) = habiroEval a ζ N

noncomputable def QOU.Habiro.habiroPoly {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a : ℕ → R) (N : ℕ) :
Polynomial R

theorem QOU.Habiro.eval_qPochPoly {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (ζ : R) (m : ℕ) :
Polynomial.eval ζ (qPochPoly R m) = Common.qPochDiag ζ m

noncomputable def QOU.Habiro.qPochPoly (R : Type u_2) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) :
Polynomial R
